paragraphs: PRG Insight is a data management and visualization system built for organizations that receive federal grants. The system collects performance measure data and structures it in dashboards describing client characteristics, participation, and targeted behavior change. Dashboard tabs can be filtered by teams, sites, or dates for site-level performance analysis or funder inquiries about specific performance periods.

The pages address CSAT and CMHS grantees using GPRA and NOMS for client-level data collection who are required to use SUPRT. The Insight system is described as including an electronic SUPRT form, follow-up and tracking alerts, and automatic upload to SPARS. Automated uploads to federal performance measure portals are presented as removing duplicate data entry, with validation tools built into the data entry tools.

Training for the electronic data entry tools and dashboard system is offered through web-based tutorials, a user guide, and an email help desk. PRG Insight comes from The Policy & Research Group, a research and evaluation firm that conducts data collection and analysis for SAMHSA-funded grant projects. Partner Feedback on the page carries testimonials attributed to a Data Evaluation Coordinator at the Minnesota Department of Human Services and to a director at Odyssey House Louisiana.

quote.text: Reduce the burden of performance data reporting and visualize structured data
